assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated item, reviewed-dedicated-analysis: the canonical V2 character reconstruction model MHA_SP2_AOYAMA_YUGA_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with the source-labeled Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its AY-SUP-01 to AY-SUP-03 sections admit. The MHA character modeling schema was consulted for method only; the readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit and the deep readings are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's strong label and its retrospective holdout probe AY-V01 are inputs, not conclusions. No original manga page, anime adaptation, V1 material or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Aoyama from the V12:p175-183 provisional-licence exam and the V18:p179-183 and V19:p020-023 cheese outreach to Midoriya, through the V34:p132-168 disclosure of his Quirkless origin, parental acquisition and coerced facilitation of the USJ and camp attacks, the V35:p007-021 and p059-075 lure and reversal of All For One's channel, and the V40:p013-022 and V41:p175-184 war actions with Hagakure, to the V42:p045-047 chosen departure and the V42:p164 adult sidekick continuity. Kept as separable states: concealing coerced student, exposed and self-condemning student, reparative field actor, departing student and adult sidekick; the classmates' ignorance before V34 is preserved and the adult role is not assigned to the student. No atom covers V01-V11, V13-V17, V20-V33 or V36-V39.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states recurring priorities (family safety under threat, equality and belonging with peers, a meaningful heroic self, expressive visibility) whose ordering shifts with coercion and exposure, a feared self that is fraudulent or permanently unworthy of relation, and an ideal self as an equal who offers light without a concealed channel. Six located atoms AY01-AY06 at high confidence; the probe AY-V01 rates motive supported. Not B: one compact artifact, one retrospective nonblind probe, and adult private breadth is OPEN. Not D: the model is operational, with state-conditioned ordering and flip conditions.

Located transitions separate imposed difference and concealment (AY01-AY02), exposure and self-condemnation (AY03), reparative action after Aizawa's intervention (AY04-AY05), chosen departure (AY06) and adult sidekick work (AY06, AY-SUP-03). The model rejects one timeless coward or redeemed label and forbids assigning the adult role backward. Not B: long intervals are unsampled and the adult state rests on one page plus supplement. Not D: change is located with explicit state variables.

The model identifies 僕, decorative ☆, theatrical address and the family terms パパン and ママン, and distinguishes ordinary sparkle, a panic confession that must not be played as comedy, admission of harm and the invitation to mutual reliance; the probe rates speech/register supported. Not C: no located lines are quoted and adult private register is stated to be under-sampled. Not E: a recurrent register and its functional variants are identified and tested on one axis. The discovery row does not enroll SPEECH.

One ordinary-life window is located: the dormitory cheese outreach to a stressed Midoriya, with the model's reading that he projected his own bodily mismatch and preferences onto the recipient (AY02, AY-SUP-01). Adult laughing with everyone as equals is a guide summary (AY-SUP-03), not an enacted routine. Not D: one occasion and no recurrent daily practice.

A five-row partner table gives conditional behavior toward his parents, Midoriya, Aizawa and Class A, Hagakure and All For One, with state deltas: Midoriya from analogy-based care (AY02) to reciprocal need (AY05), Hagakure from anger after disclosure to professional partnership (AY05-AY06), All For One from threat-based compliance to resistance (AY03-AY04). The probe rates relationship handling supported. Not B: parent conduct and adult relations are sampled thinly. Not D: several partners have located, state-conditioned deltas.

Located interior states are recalled difference and the wish for equality (AY01), self-totalizing as an enemy after confession (AY03) and doubt of his own worth before Aizawa's intervention (AY04); the model distinguishes classmates' trust from his own self-trust and says persistence does not prove shame cured. C rejected: regulation is described in general terms, the probe's emotional trajectory is partial and full future adjustment is unobserved. Not E: several located reflective windows exist.

The decision policy is explicit by condition: under active coercion, family danger drives concealment and compliance; under disclosure and shame, self-exclusion; with concrete trust and an actionable reversal route, risky reparative action; postwar, a future hero aim while declining the easiest continuation. Flip conditions are stated (a new credible family threat or acute shame). Located in AY01 and AY03-AY05; the probe rates action partial because the exact choice was underdetermined. Not B: one probe, partial on action. Not D: the policy is explicit, located and conditioned.

Two located choices weigh competing goods: coerced facilitation of attacks under lethal threat to his parents (AY03) and departure toward atonement although permitted to stay (AY06, directly checked). The model distinguishes coercion as explanation from acquittal, rejects forgiveness-by-success, and says repair does not entitle him to dictate others' responses. Not B: his reasoning is inferred from choices and confessions rather than an analyzed internal weighing, and the probe found the two routes underdetermined. Not D: located choices with named competing considerations. The discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.

Theatrical sparkle and surprise are located as presentation and care (AY01-AY02) and a theatrical farewell style survives accountability (AY06); the model forbids playing a panic confession as light comedy. Not D: play is described as register and presentation, with no analyzed humor practice across partners.

The project's analytical corpus is complete for V01-V42 and the admitted supplements; six atoms span V12-V42 with page locators, and V41 and V42 decisive pages were directly checked. No atom covers V01-V11, V13-V17, V20-V33 or V36-V39, the adult state is one page, and the supplements are profile facts, editorial summaries and an author comment.

Affirmative limits are located: the model REJECTs permanent enemy essence and forgiveness-by-success, REVISEs vanity-only and innocent-passivity accounts, finds no lifelong ideological allegiance to All For One, says carrying messages gives no access to All For One's intentions, records that Shinso's compelled speech is a sensor workaround rather than evidence he became an undetectable liar, preserves classmates' and Midoriya's earlier ignorance (AY-SUP-01), and forbids attributing Mirio's negative-to-zero phrase to him. Not B: limits rest on few windows in one artifact.

Every atom is page-located, the V31 page convention is stated, reader disclosure in V34 is separated from classmates' knowledge in V12 or V19, and the adult sidekick position is not assigned to the student. Not B: long intervals are unsampled and in-world dates are not given.

scenario_readiness.note: The model states that generated dialogue would be an illustrative prediction, never an attributed quotation, and quotes no located lines; register markers are named but adult private register is under-sampled. Lines beyond the described register would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Aoyama's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named state, stated explicitly: concealing coerced student before V34, exposed student V34-V35, reparative field actor V35-V41, or postwar student at V42; no adult role, license or Hagakure partnership is given to the student, and the classmates' pre-V34 ignorance is preserved.
The interlocutor is a parent, Midoriya, Aizawa or a Class A peer, Hagakure or All For One, handled as the partner table gives; no invented private or romantic relationship.
The acquired Navel Laser keeps its bodily strain and belt support; paired refraction is not unlimited solo capacity, and he has no knowledge of All For One's intentions beyond what he was told.

Output is a behavioral description with alternatives and flip conditions, giving two-route uncertainty where the model does; no quoted dialogue is produced as canon and no readiness is inherited from the strong label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: concealing student, exposed student, reparative field actor or postwar student, stated explicitly.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Parents, Midoriya, Aizawa and Class A, Hagakure or All For One, in the relation the partner table gives for that state.
setting_constraints: School, coercion, disclosure or wartime hero operation
Quirk embodiment and knowledge limits respected
No adult private, family-home, leisure or romantic setting

scenario_readiness.note: The model's stated hypothetical (postwar Aoyama offered a chance to contribute without assurance of praise; participation medium-high from AY05, changed by a new credible family threat or acute shame) and the probe's preserved two-route uncertainty support narrow novel scenes. The probe is retrospective, nonblind and partial on action and emotion.

The only located ordinary social window is the cheese outreach (AY02); the model marks adult private life OPEN and too thin for specialist readiness, and adult laughter with peers is a guide summary rather than enacted conduct.

conditions: The dilemma concerns accountability, repair or protection of family and peers after V34 disclosure, with the coercion history and the state named.
Output distinguishes explanation from acquittal, keeps repair from dictating others' responses, and gives alternatives rather than a point prediction where the model found the choice underdetermined.
Detailed legal aftermath and adult moral conflicts are not predicted; the model marks them OPEN.
scenario_readiness.note: Two located choices (AY03 coerced compliance under lethal family threat, AY06 chosen departure despite permission) and the probe, which supported motive but found the exact route underdetermined, support bounded accountability dilemmas only.

The evidence set establishes neither romantic conduct nor its absence; the Hagakure partnership is professional and the model says it does not establish romantic reciprocity. This gap says nothing about the character.

conditions: The setting is a supervised or coordinated hero operation after V35, including paired refraction work with Hagakure, with the state stated.
Output preserves the beam's bodily limits, fear persisting alongside action (AY-SUP-02) and participation without guaranteed readmission or praise.
Independent adult agency work, legal process and career decisions beyond the recorded Hagakure sidekick fact are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Field action is located in the V35 lure and reversal (AY04) and the V40-V41 war actions with Hagakure (AY05); the adult licensed sidekick role is one page plus a guide fact (AY06, AY-SUP-03).

known_limits.statement: Lethal coercion against his family explains his facilitation of the USJ and camp attacks without making the acts nonexistent; guilt does not purchase innocence and repair does not entitle him to dictate others' responses (AY03-AY04).
No permanent enemy essence or lifelong ideological allegiance to All For One is established; threat-based compliance became resistance when conditions and support changed.

He knows the family threat and his own acts before the class does but not All For One's wider intentions; classmates, including Midoriya at the cheese exchange, lacked the origin and coercion knowledge before V34 (AY-SUP-01).

The acquired Navel Laser strains his body and needs belt support; paired refraction extends the beam without proving unlimited solo capacity, and Shinso's compelled speech was a sensor workaround, not evidence he became an undetectable liar.
The V42 departure, later license and Hagakure sidekick position are not assigned to the student, and V34 reader disclosure is not classmates' knowledge in V12 or V19.
Flamboyance is not evidence that vanity dominates: conspicuousness serves coordination (AY01), awkward care (AY02) and survives accountability (AY06); a panic confession is not light comedy.
The probe found staying with accountability and departing toward atonement both plausible from AY01-AY05; the departure is located fact, not a choice the earlier evidence predicts as a point.

Adult private life, varied independent adult conflicts, legal particulars and private relationships are OPEN or thin in the model; the Hagakure partnership establishes professional reintegration, not romantic reciprocity.

Supplement profile facts, editorial summaries and the author comment (AY-SUP-01 to AY-SUP-03) constrain reconstruction without becoming enacted manga observations; his French origin is his own claim, not verified nationality.
The single formal probe AY-V01 is a retrospective chronological evidence holdout by an analyst who had read later manga, not a blind experiment; action and emotional trajectory were partial.
No atom covers V01-V11, V13-V17, V20-V33 or V36-V39, so behavior over those intervals is not established by this evidence set.

The deep readings, readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not independently rechecked here. Anime performance and any supplement material beyond what the model cites lie outside this evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
